Not every moment needs to be rushed 🤍

Sometimes, the most meaningful thing you can do is pause, breathe, and reconnect with yourself. Take this as your gentle reminder to slow down today.

Dealing with fibroids? Try this gentle yoga poses

Fibroids means navigating bloating, chronic pelvic pain, heavy cycles, and the emotional stress that comes with hormonal imbalances. While yoga isn't a direct cure, the right kind of movement can be medicine for your body. In our latest YouTube video, we have shared a deeply restorative, gentle sequence specifically designed for fibroid relief.

By focusing on soft pelvic openers, mild inversions, and calming breathwork, this practice helps to:

✅ Improve blood flow to the reproductive organs

✅ Release deep tension in the lower back and pelvic floor

✅ Lower stress levels (cortisol), which plays a huge role in balancing hormones
They say your vibe attracts your tribe, and we’ve definitely found ours ❤️

Level up your Trikonasana with this core-strengthening variation!✨

Triangle Pose is incredible for opening up the chest and lengthening the spine. But when you introduce a theraband and support yourself on a gym ball, it completely changes the game.
Adding the resistance band instantly activates your obliques and shoulders, while stabilizing yourself on the gym ball forces your deep core muscles to fire up. It’s the perfect blend of alignment, resistance, and balance. In this video, we break down the exact step-by-step setup so you can try it safely.

Save this post to add to your next core or flexibility routine!

featured_reviews.name: KartiK Mittal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hidden haven in Bandra that feels like a deep breath

Stumbled upon this gem on the District app while wandering through Bandra. The Yoga House is one of those classic Bandra homes turned into a calm, airy cafe. You won’t spot a flashy sign from the road, so trust Google Maps and keep your eyes peeled for a quiet villa entrance. A staff member guided us upstairs. The first floor looks set up for yoga, and the cafe opens out on the second.

Seating is split into three moods. Indoors for soft light and calm conversations. A leafy outdoor section for sunshine and breezes. And one level up, a shamiana style nook where you sit cross-legged and forget time. It feels like a friend’s mindful terrace more than a commercial cafe.

We picked an outside table. Peaceful. Not crowded. Bandra energy without the traffic noise. Service was warm and unhurried. We tried their Summer Salad. Fruity, crunchy, and bright with mixed produce. Roughly ₹545 all in. Portion was decent and left us satisfied. Prices lean premium, but you are paying for the setting and the slow, healthy focus.

What I loved

1. Tucked away location that keeps it serene

2. Variety of seating that lets you choose your vibe

3. Staff that actually looks after you without hovering

Good to know:
•	Harder to spot from the street, so navigate straight to “The Yoga House” near Nargis Villa or Water Bungalow

•	Menu skews healthy and light. Great if that is your mood, not ideal if you want heavy mains

Verdict:
Come here when you need a gentle pause in the middle of Bandra. Perfect for solo journaling, slow brunch with a book, or a catch-up where you can actually hear each other. If you like trying unique, aesthetic spaces and don’t mind spending a little extra for quiet and quality, this one belongs on your list.

featured_reviews.name: Mandar Khatkul
featured_reviews.review_text:
For years, life in advertising taught me how to survive on deadlines, stress, late nights, parties and alcohol. Somewhere along the way, I had stopped listening to my own body. At my heaviest, I was 93 kgs. Low energy became normal. Frustration became normal. Even the face in the mirror slowly stopped looking like me.
And then came Yoga.
And more importantly — ‘Prana By Enrica.’

What makes ‘Prana by Enrica’ special is not just that she teaches yoga. She understands the human body deeply. Her knowledge of anatomy is honestly remarkable. Every stretch, every breath, every correction has a purpose behind it. She knows exactly when to push you, when to slow you down, and when your body simply needs awareness instead of effort.

Her teaching style is warm, friendly and comforting… but she is also extremely particular about consistency and homework. And that discipline changes you.

Over time, my weight dropped from 93 kgs to 75 kgs. But the real transformation was not just physical.
Breathing improved.
Stamina improved.
Mobility improved.
The belly fat reduced.
The core became stronger.
Mental fog slowly disappeared.
And with calmness came clarity.

Today at 46, I genuinely feel younger, lighter and more alive — almost like I’m back in my 30s. Sometimes I look at old photographs and can’t believe I’m the same person. The face changes when the mind becomes peaceful. Confidence quietly returns.

One of my favourite moments in class is 'Shavasana'. There’s something incredibly healing about hearing Enrica’s calm voice guiding you through relaxation, slowly helping every part of the body let go. There have been days when I’ve completely drifted off to sleep — not out of tiredness, but out of absolute surrender and peace. It feels like getting lost exactly where you want to be.

From consuming Old Monk…
to looking like a Shaolin Monk…
This journey would not have been possible without ‘Prana by Enrica’. If someone is looking for yoga only as exercise, they will benefit. But if someone is looking for transformation — physical, mental and emotional — then 'Prana By Enrica' is truly special.

featured_reviews.name: Neil Pinheiro
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been learning yoga with Enrica for over 2 years and would highly recommend her. Every class feels different in a good way, and she clearly explains the asanas and breathwork, and how they help your body and mind.

She played a huge role in my recovery from a high-grade wrist injury I had for almost 5 years. After multiple doctors suggested surgery, her yoga practice, along with her out-of-the-box suggestions and guidance on lifestyle and diet, helped me fully recover. My wrist is now pain-free.

She’s also very friendly and humorous, which makes every class enjoyable and something I look forward to.

Highly recommend her to anyone looking to learn yoga.

I've been training with Enrica for 2 years in private 1-on-1 sessions, and the results have been measurable and consistent.
Her approach is grounded in anatomy and structural alignment, which makes a real difference. She identifies imbalances, corrects posture methodically, and ensures every pose is performed safely and effectively. Within months, my chronic upper back pain had reduced significantly. Over time, my flexibility, core strength, and overall body awareness have all improved substantially.
Equally important has been the impact on my stress and mental clarity — the sessions serve as a genuine reset in the middle of a demanding week. For any professional looking for a structured, results-driven yoga practice, Enrica is outstanding.
